info.title: Message History API
info.description:
Provides methods for querying the message history for a given profile.
Returns messages in descending chronological order from a specified date,
allowing callers to page through the full history of messages sent to or
from that profile across all channels.

region.description: The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to

get.summary: Retrieves message history for the specified profile.  Messages retrieved from the date spacified (default now), in descending time order.

parameters.name: channelId
parameters.description: The id of the channel the message was sent or received on

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The date (in UTC, ISO 8601 format) to query backwards from

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

200.description: List of messages matching the criteria

messageId.description: The unique id for the message.

submittedOn.description: The date/time the message was submitted to the platform.

profileId.description: The id of the profile that the message relates to

channelId.description: The id of the channel the message was sent/received on

direction.description: Indicates whether the message was outbound (from Comapi) or inbound (from the profile)

title.description: The message title (if appropriate / supported for the channel)

channelData.description: The channel specific data for the message

fromQueryParameter.name: from
fromQueryParameter.description: The date (in UTC, ISO 8601 format) to query backwards from

limitQueryParameter.name: limit
limitQueryParameter.description: Maximum number of results to return

channelQueryParameter.name: channelId
channelQueryParameter.description: The id of the channel the message was sent or received on

conversationQueryParameter.name: conversationId
conversationQueryParameter.description: The id of the conversation the message was sent or received on
